From: chloe_martin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + PO inclusion (Q3 onboarding)

Hi Elena — thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Short answer: we support both flows; here's how teams typically set it up and the tradeoffs so you can pick the one that fits NovaFleet: 

Option A — Portal-first (recommended for AP + archival):
- Redwood will publish each invoice to your NovaFleet portal tenancy (PDF + structured UBL/JSON payload).
- We can send a configurable email copy to accounts@novafleet.com after publish.
- Benefits: centralized archive, webhook/webhook+webhook replay for your ERP, and better search/retention controls.

Option B — Email-only (fastest):
- We email PDF invoices directly to accounts@novafleet.com (and optionally cc a billing contact).
- Simpler but harder to programmatically ingest at scale; limited replay and no webhook.

Regarding PO inclusion and tax fields:
- We can inject PO# onto invoice header and each invoice line as you prefer.
- Tax/VAT: we support tax_id, tax_rate, tax_amount fields in the structured payload and as a visible line in the PDF.

Next steps we need from you to proceed:
1) Confirm preferred delivery method (Portal-first with email copy OR Email-only).
2) Billing contact (name + email) to invite to the portal (Portal-first only).
3) Desired sequencing: single monthly consolidated invoice OR per-charge / per-invoice delivery.

I’ve looped in Ben (finance) and Marissa (onboarding) to provide the sample payload and setup checklist. If you want, we can schedule a short 20-min call this week to walk credentials and webhook examples.

— Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Elena Voss <elena@novafleet.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery + PO inclusion (Q3 onboarding)

Hi Elena / Chloe,

Ben from Finance here — attaching a sample structured invoice schema we push from the portal and a short checklist for onboarding. Key points:

- Payloads: we publish PDF + an accompanying XML/UBL (attached: einvoice_sample_schema.xml). The XML includes fields: invoice_id, issue_date, due_date, lines[{po_number, description, qty, unit_price, tax_amount}], tax_summary, billing_contact, tax_id.
- Sequencing:
  * Consolidated monthly statement: single invoice aggregating all charges for the month (preferred for higher-level AP teams).
  * Per-charge invoices: we emit one invoice per charge; better for charge-level reconciliation but increases invoice count.
- Delivery options supported: Portal webhook (recommended), SFTP drop, or direct email PDF. Portal requires an admin invite from your side (we’ll send an invite to the billing contact).
- Retention/archival: Redwood retains portal copies for 7 years by default; we can extend on request.

Onboarding checklist (what we need from NovaFleet):
1) Confirm delivery method (Portal-first + email copy OR Email-only).
2) Billing contact (full name, email, and whether that contact should be a portal admin).
3) PO injection rule: header-level only OR header + per-line.
4) Desired sequencing: monthly consolidated OR per-invoice.
5) Go-live target date.

Attachment: einvoice_sample_schema.xml (XML, 12KB)

If Portal-first: Chloe, can you coordinate sending the portal admin invite once Elena confirms the billing contact? We’ll preconfigure the PO injection and tax fields on our side.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
